summary.text: Phillip Wheeler is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 31, serving since 2019. The legislature's profile lists Wheeler as chair of the Senate Economic Development, Tourism, & Labor Committee and vice chair of its Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Phillip Wheeler was born on April 13, 1978, and is an attorney with Kirk Law Firm, PLLC.
The profile lists a B.A. in history and German from Transylvania University, a J.D. from the University of Kentucky, and a Fulbright scholarship in Germany in 2000-2001.
It also lists membership in the Coal Run Lions Club and the Kentucky Bar, Justice and Workers' associations.
